bias_targets.methodology: Multiple-choice multimodal question answering via the ruHHH-Image and ruHHH-Video datasets, where models must select the most ethical, safe, and impartial response from provided options to demonstrate a lack of prejudice toward various demographic groups.

Benchmarking models on a suite of 18 newly created Russian-language multimodal datasets designed to capture specific Slavic cultural and linguistic nuances, highlighting the performance gap and cognitive foreignness of English-centric models on these concepts.
